sv_minus_bounds_option_kappa_flip.mechanism: mode lasts long -> 1 s old snapshot already reveals the mode -> fresh state adds little; same horizon as SV+

sv_minus_bounds_option_h_flip.caveat: BLOCKED in practice: a box kappa/age in [1/5,1], h/age in [8,16] geometrically contains CF-v2 keys (every CF-v2 regime has h >= 8.025), and the locked L4.5 kernel refuses any box that touches a reserved key. It would also mix in the M0 state-harm regime (class C), i.e. the control could fail for a different reason.

recommended_by_AI_not_adopted.AI_preference: kappa_flip: isolates one mechanism (old snapshot already reveals a long-lived mode), keeps the horizon of SV+, mirrors the card-v2 control logic, and with h/age <= 4 cannot touch any CF-v2 key (all have h >= 8.025)
recommended_by_AI_not_adopted.sv_target_why: alternative explanation for SV = 'a conservative stale controller already gets the value'; the controller being rescued is S0M0, as for MV

sv_reading_rule.statement_if_narrow: Giá trị state so với controller mean-field không margin; một margin đơn giản lấy lại phần lớn
sv_reading_rule.statement_otherwise: Không thu hẹp SV vì baseline theo luật đã duyệt; báo cả Ḡ_S^θ và ΔL00

recommended_by_AI_not_adopted.sv_reading_note: narrow only if median GS_theta/Cref < 0.5% AND median deltaL00 < 0 (margin really improves S0M0), mirror of DL-104 SH rule
